source_read: https://sohocoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-Nutritional-Matrix-Drinks-V4-Autumn-Drinks-26.08.26-1.pdf (41 pages, downloaded afresh 2026-10-08, byte-identical to the copy used for data/source; robots.txt only disallows a WP Defender trap path) and the allergen matrix PDF (also byte-identical)
notes: All 198 published rows (and the 15 already held back) matched against an independent pdftotext -layout parse of the 9 printed columns (kJ, kcal, fat, sat fat, carbs, sugars, fibre, protein, salt) and the product-name text next to each row; 12 sample rows plus 8 more across pages 4, 12, 27, 32, 35, 37 (add-ons, syrups, smoothies, seasonal, matcha, chai) rendered and read by eye: no difference. Vegetarian tag cross-checked by counting the Y marks in the Vegetarian column (179 = 169 published products + 10 products on the excluded travel/Westfield pages); the 2 products with no tag are blank cells in the guide itself (Vanilla Matcha skimmed milk; Mini Marshmallows, contains_pork from the pork gelatine). Allergens are link-only for this chain (matrix lists whole milk only), so no allergen marks are published to check. Held-back kJ/kcal contradictions stay held because this chain publishes kJ.
